bluetooth_confirm.title: Confirm your heater
bluetooth_confirm.description:
Found **{name}** with MAC address **{address}** (signal {rssi} dBm).

This heater has no Bluetooth pairing or password, so **any BougeRV heater within range can be added**, including one that isn't yours. Confirm this is your heater before continuing:

1. In the BougeRV app, open the heater and tap the settings (gear) icon.
2. Check that the MAC address shown there is **{address}**.

If the app doesn't show a MAC address, unplug your heater for a minute and start discovery again: your heater will not be listed while it is unplugged.

data.mac_confirmed: I have checked that this MAC address belongs to my heater

user.title: Choose your heater
user.description:
Choose your heater. The strongest signal (closest to 0 dBm) is usually the nearest one.

This heater has no Bluetooth pairing or password, so **any BougeRV heater within range can be added**, including one that isn't yours. Confirm the MAC address before continuing:

1. In the BougeRV app, open the heater and tap the settings (gear) icon.
2. Check that the MAC address shown there matches the one you select below.

If the app doesn't show a MAC address, unplug your heater for a minute and start again: your heater will not be listed while it is unplugged.

data.mac_confirmed: I have checked that this MAC address belongs to my heater

error.confirm_mac: Confirm the MAC address matches your heater before continuing.

abort.already_configured: This heater is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No BougeRV standard diesel heaters were found. Make sure the heater is plugged in and within Bluetooth range of Home Assistant or a Bluetooth proxy.
abort.not_supported: This BougeRV device is not a supported standard diesel heater.

not_connected.message: The heater is not connected. Wait until its status is available, then try again.

write_failed.message: The command could not be sent to the heater. Check the Bluetooth connection, then try again.

not_confirmed.message: The heater did not confirm the command. Check the heater's state before trying again.

fault_active.message: The heater reports a fault. Resolve the fault before starting the heater or changing its output.

cooling_down.message: The heater is shutting down. Wait until the cool-down finishes and it shows Off.

starting.message: The heater is still starting. It can be turned off once it reaches Running.

output_heater_off.message: Heat output can only be changed while the heater is starting or running.

output_out_of_range.message: Heat output must be between 1.4 and 5.0 kW.

init.title: Thermostat
init.description:
Choose a temperature sensor in the heated space to create a **Thermostat** entity. It is disabled by default: enable it on the device page to use it.

Output is adjusted first. The heater is stopped only when the room stays above the target by the stop margin at minimum output, and restarted when it falls below the target by the restart margin.

data.sensor_timeout_minutes: Shut down if the sensor stops updating for (minutes)

data_description.temperature_sensor: Leave empty to remove the thermostat.
data_description.sensor_timeout_minutes: Pick a value longer than the sensor's longest normal gap between updates.

onboard_schedule_conflict.title: {name}: onboard schedule is active
onboard_schedule_conflict.description:
The heater's onboard schedule is on with these hours selected: {hours}. The heater will start itself at those times even if the Home Assistant thermostat is off.

If you control the heater with the thermostat, clear the schedule hours or turn the schedule off in the BougeRV app (heater → Timing Configuration).
